comment.body: Thanks for the screenshots and the comparison with the mapped drive. The maintainer has now suggested creating a bookmark for the drive and pinning that bookmark. Please try that Add bookmark route for C:\ and confirm whether it creates the dock item you wanted. If not, name the exact bookmark-creation or pinning step that fails.
